summary: Tested dual-role Admin↔Parent + change-email E2E. Backend: 6 pytest, 5/6 pass; one minor edge case (invalid slot accepted as primary). Frontend: verified visually via Playwright — /admin header now shows a purple people icon (bg #F3E5F5) that navigates to /parent; /parent shows ONLY the linked child (GIULIA), not all 51 society athletes; /parent header has shield icon back-to-staff that correctly returns admin to /admin; /admin/athlete/[id] Anagrafica tab shows the green pill 'Sei collegato come genitore di questo atleta' once linked and hides the link button. Change-email endpoint validated via curl: 400 for wrong password, 400 for duplicate email, 200 for valid change + re-login with new email works. DB state (Vinz email + GIULIA parent_id + second_parent_id) fully restored to original.

minor.issue: Invalid slot value (e.g. 'bogus') is accepted and silently treated as primary (returns 200). Backend should validate slot ∈ {'primary','secondary'} and return 400/422.

ui_bugs.issue: As noted in iter 83, JSX data-testid on <TouchableOpacity>/<Modal> does not propagate through react-native-web. All new testids in iter 84 (admin-switch-to-parent-btn, dirigente-parent-switch-card, coord-switch-to-parent-btn, link-me-as-parent-btn, parent-back-to-staff-btn, settings-change-email-btn, change-email-submit-btn) return 0 in the DOM. Functionality works visually and via coordinate/text selectors, but automated e2e testids will fail. Use testID={...} (RN native) instead of data-testid.

action_items: BACKEND: validate `slot` payload on POST /api/athletes/{id}/link-me-as-parent — reject values not in {'primary','secondary'} with 400.
FRONTEND (test tooling only): replace data-testid=... with testID=... on TouchableOpacity/Pressable/Modal to expose selectors in the DOM. Not blocking functionality.
critical_code_review_comments: New endpoints (link-me-as-parent, parent-of, change-email) correctly enforce society-scoped access and password verification. change-email correctly checks case-insensitive uniqueness and rejects duplicates.
/api/athletes/my dual-role branching correctly returns children-only when the staff user has ≥1 linked athlete — no data leak observed after linking/unlinking flow.
Slot value not validated in link-me-as-parent (see minor issue) — data-integrity concern if a malformed client sends unexpected strings.

success_rate.frontend: 100% functional/visual (data-testid selectors unavailable due to react-native-web, but flows verified via text/coordinates)
